**Why it wasn't approved:** policy blocks automatic approval for untrusted vendors, so I did not attempt approval. The invoice is saved as a draft and has been sent to a human reviewer with that reason. Note that even if the vendor were trusted, the GBP 288.00 gross total would still need to be checked against the automatic approval ceiling — a reviewer can confirm both points.

One thing worth flagging for the reviewer: the invoice date wasn't stated on the paper document, so I entered 2025-01-01 as a placeholder — that should be corrected to the actual issue date.
